'''Zeth Bresque''' was a [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosar]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]]. She was also an addict to [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]].

==Biography==
In around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[A Mon Alone]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Bresque had been captured by slaver [[Phylus Mon]] and kept in a cell in Mon's slave zoo aboard the ''[[Animiasma]]''. Her cell had a slot and a lever so that Bresque could get a new death stick whenever she wanted. This was apparently an experiment to see how long she could survive with a constant supply of her drugs. As a result, she was ''not'' anxious to leave.

Phylus Mon surgically inserted an explosive near the heart of each of his slaves. The explosive would be activated in the case of Phylus Mon's death, but it could also be deactivated with the impact of an [[ion blaster]]. All the slaves in Phylus Mon's zoo were also regularly battered.
